results.problem: Versatile and efficient volumetric editing with disentangled neural mesh-based implicit field
results.bound: NeuMesh++: mesh-based neural radiance representation with disentangled geometry, texture, and semantic codes on mesh vertices
results.quote: In this paper, we present a novel mesh-based representation by encoding the neural radiance field with disentangled geometry, texture, and semantic codes on mesh vertices, which empowers a set of efficient and comprehensive editing functionalities, including mesh-guided geometry editing, designated texture editing with texture swapping, filling and painting operations, and semantic-guided editing.

results.problem: Novel view synthesis with neural mesh-based radiance field
results.quote: NeuMesh++ can reach 15 fps on Nvidia GTX 4070 GPU when rendering 800×800 images.

results.problem: Texture painting on neural radiance fields
results.quote: For texture painting, we only fine-tune the modification color (decoder-free) on the painted region which only takes about 1 second.
For semantic-guided editing, it only takes about 2 seconds for the 3D semantic propagation from clicking on a single-perspective image.
